description.value: Marais Tea Company & Café is a specialty tea purveyor and café in Chilliwack sourcing fine teas from premier growing regions worldwide, including single-origin orthodox teas, blended black teas, matcha, and herbal infusions. The business operates both a physical café with outdoor seating and an active online retail store, offering a calm, intentional pause for those wanting a carefully steeped cup. Notably, the café accepts Bitcoin and Lightning Network payments — an unusual feature for a small-town tea house.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record (surveyed 2025-08-20) identifies this as an active café at 9375 Mill Street, Chilliwack, with outdoor_seating=yes; the website corroborates a physical retail presence via the phrase 'in-store and online' and a Shopify POS system, confirming the business is operational. The website is overwhelmingly e-commerce focused on loose-leaf tea and provides no detail on cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are not mentioned, leaving those fields null. OSM tags internet_access=no from the same 2025-08-20 survey, but per rules this OSM tag alone is insufficient to set value=false without website corroboration.
concerns: Website is primarily e-commerce focused; in-person café amenities (washrooms, bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are not described — manual on-site verification recommended before publishing.
OSM tags internet_access=no (surveyed 2025-08-20) but this could not be confirmed or denied via website content.
Phone number and physical address are not displayed on the website contact page; OSM values cannot be cross-confirmed from available web content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active specialty tea café with outdoor seating in Chilliwack; a legitimate food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists, though cycling-specific amenities require on-site verification.
